notes: The round-6 item-4 defect is fixed. dest is now `EXEC *`, the copy is `*dest = *(EXEC *)&sp_buf[0x10]`, and the read uses dest->t_size / dest->t_addr. EXEC is declared once (include/system.h:42-49) and matches the PsyQ libapi layout. There is no pin, asm, volatile or FAKE-needing construct; every local carries a real value; and the leading comment is true: D_8008F12C[6]=156 as s16, and g_cd_file_table entry 156 has size 124928, which equals disc/STR/MOVOVL.EXE. sandbox --disable all scores 0 (72/72).
